entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme
observations: Sequence analysis found reviewed Swiss-Prot homologs at 37.7–38.7% identity over 86.8–88.2% query coverage (E-values 3.24e-58 to 4.78e-59).

Homolog annotations support NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of (6S)-NAD(P)HX to restore NAD(P)H; inferred biological processes are metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolism.
